shots.line: See a face at the rear window, and you'll brake. And braking is slow.
shots.scene: Frontal close-up through the windshield; rear-left headrest and rear glass dark behind YOU; mirror tilted up at the roof.
shots.purpose: Narrator's cover story for not touching the mirror.
shots.visual_change: Right hand lowers from beside the mirror to the wheel rim (contact 4.6 s); sodium pool sweeps the cabin.

shots.line: Pull over under the next streetlight.
shots.scene: Three-quarter from the passenger seat; centre screen in the foreground switches from map to a call screen.
shots.purpose: The breach begins: the narrator's own voice comes out of the car.
shots.visual_change: Screen switches at 6.60; blue light rises on YOU's face and rim; eyes flick to the screen at 6.90.

shots.line: Get out and check the rear-left latch yourself.
shots.scene: ECU centre screen: Incoming audio / Unknown device, live waveform, Phone not connected.
shots.purpose: The one true instruction in the film.
shots.visual_change: Waveform follows the hijack audio; call timer counts.

shots.line: Please disregard that last instruction. Do not take your foot off the gas.
shots.scene: Same screen: 4-frame static failure, then the map returns.
shots.visual_change: Static 11.75-11.88 (picture and sound), then the map.

shots.scene: Wide exterior side view: the car passes through one streetlamp's pool without slowing.
shots.purpose: YOU drives past the streetlight the voice meant.
shots.visual_change: Lamp pool crosses the car around 17.9 s.
